description:
Implement shortening as a generic linear-code transformation over arbitrary coordinate sets: restrict to codewords zero on the chosen coordinates, delete them, derive the resulting dimension by rank, and report the resulting information-set structure.

## Background

Dimension follows from rank, not a count formula, and the result need not stay systematic in the original positions. Count-based helpers cover the conventional systematic positions. The rank/information-set machinery built here is shared by puncturing.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Shortening accepts arbitrary coordinate sets on any generic linear code, derives dimension by rank, reports the information-set structure, and preserves its coordinate map.
- [hard] REQ-02: Count-based helpers delegate to the coordinate-set form, and invalid coordinate sets report the coding-general error layer.
- [hard] REQ-03: Property tests verify dimension-by-rank against direct generator-matrix computation, including non-systematic cases, over binary and nonbinary codes.
title: Generic shortening over arbitrary coordinate sets
